packages.question: Does weighting improve fixed-target empirical fidelity?
packages.methods_and_scope: 54 corrected Adult development cells; 12 frozen confirmation cells; same locally tuned models and five 10k draws
packages.metric: alpha-standardized Q_primary_v2 query max; constrained minus size
packages.completed_scope: 0/18 Adult development and 0/6 confirmation partition/K slices reached -0.005; overall confirmation delta -0.000215
packages.unresolved_scope: Other populations, workloads and privacy-matched aggregation
packages.retained_claim: No registered practical constrained gain; retain size weighting
packages.forbidden_claim: A general weighting-improvement or equivalence claim
packages.stop_criterion: All registered Adult development and frozen confirmation cells terminal; compare the same alpha target and retain every adverse slice.

packages.question: How close are candidates to a finite-pilot oracle?
packages.methods_and_scope: 57 certified fixed-pilot LPs; six-cell four-size/five-seed pilot sensitivity
packages.metric: LP certificate, pilot regret and fresh-sample query loss
packages.completed_scope: Finite matrix optimum certified; larger pilots reduced numerical excess but did not establish practical fresh-sample gain
packages.unresolved_scope: Population optimum or globally optimal nonlinear operators
packages.retained_claim: Oracle is conditional on fixed synthetic H and empirical target
packages.stop_criterion: Every finite-pilot LP status/certificate retained and the predeclared pilot-size study terminal; do not claim a population optimum.

packages.question: Do overlapping client subsets add mixture expressivity?
packages.methods_and_scope: Cyclic subset effective-weight identity and saved numerical check
packages.metric: Equality of effective client mass and resulting mixture
packages.completed_scope: Mixtures of subset mixtures collapse to one global mixture
packages.retained_claim: Subset regrouping alone adds no expressive family
packages.stop_criterion: Algebraic collapse proved and a saved cyclic example has zero effective-weight identity error; no extra expressive model claimed.

packages.question: What changes with synthetic sample size?
packages.methods_and_scope: Six checkpoints, m=2500/10000/40000, five draws each
packages.metric: query error, draw variation, diversity, runtime
packages.completed_scope: Draw variation shrank; model error persisted; no practical constrained gain
packages.unresolved_scope: Other families or very large m
packages.retained_claim: Sampling more rows does not repair observed model bias in these cells
packages.stop_criterion: Five draws at each registered m share fixed checkpoints; separate draw variation from model-error plateau and retain diversity/runtime.

packages.question: When does conditional synthesis succeed or abstain?
packages.methods_and_scope: Six development student/direct-teacher cells; frozen 12-cell four-condition confirmation
packages.metric: support, acceptance, violations, within-condition query max
packages.completed_scope: Direct teacher default; older-doctorate request abstained 12/12. Female-condition relationship=Husband was the worst query in all 12 confirmation cells: zero alpha-standardized real frequency, generated 0.340?0.399, mean absolute error 0.375 despite zero condition violations.
packages.unresolved_scope: Arbitrary-condition fidelity certification or learned cross-condition generalization
packages.retained_claim: Support-gated rejection is operationally valid for registered requests; fidelity still limited
packages.stop_criterion: Registered teacher/student comparison and off-seed support audit terminal; accepted rows satisfy requests, low-support requests abstain, and within-condition errors remain visible.

packages.question: Does synthetic training preserve income probability utility?
packages.methods_and_scope: Paired logistic/extra-trees, synthetic TSTR and privileged real TRTR, six development and 12 confirmation cells
packages.metric: Brier, AUROC, AUPRC, log loss, subgroup coverage
packages.completed_scope: At registered unequal budgets, size logistic Brier 0.129818 versus privileged TRTR 0.101987 and AUROC 0.856167 versus 0.904646. TRTR used 21,148/4,880/3,254 real train/tune/calibration rows versus 10,000/2,000/2,000 generated rows; no matched-size effect inferred.
packages.unresolved_scope: Independent cohort utility and small unsupported subgroups
packages.retained_claim: Real-trained reference outperformed synthetic-trained predictors at this scope
packages.stop_criterion: Same-person TSTR/TRTR proper scores, calibration and supported client/subgroup counts retained; no test-derived tuning or synthetic-over-real claim.

packages.question: Can a joint model imply an income predictor?
packages.methods_and_scope: Six same-person projected development comparisons; exact finite Chow-Liu route and approximate GMM route
packages.metric: paired Brier/AUROC, two-label mass, abstention coverage
packages.completed_scope: Observed-row coverage 100%; exact-score preimages audited; approximate routes labelled
packages.unresolved_scope: Universal off-support coverage and exact copula/GMM probabilities
packages.retained_claim: Exactness is limited to declared discrete projected model
packages.stop_criterion: Projected discrete score exactness checked with preimages, approximate routes labelled, zero-denominator policy stated and same-person predictions saved.

packages.question: Which queries fail?
packages.methods_and_scope: 10,500 development query answers, 175 queries; frozen official primary/audit answers
packages.metric: max/mean error, arity, support, named worst query
packages.completed_scope: Official size primary mean 0.022216; dominant HS-grad/high-income query in 33/60 size draws
packages.unresolved_scope: Arbitrary-query guarantee; independent inference from viewed audit
packages.retained_claim: Finite-workload maxima are reproducible and named
packages.forbidden_claim: Population TV or universal query accuracy
packages.stop_criterion: All registered query definitions/answers and named maxima retained with arity/support and target-role labels; viewed audits are not called independent.

packages.question: Which registered components explain results?
packages.methods_and_scope: 12 same-row projection, six fixed-checkpoint summary-access ablations, historical capacity comparison
packages.metric: paired primary/query errors and access bytes
packages.completed_scope: Structural repair and access changes matter; no isolated component establishes a practical general weighting gain
packages.retained_claim: Component effects only for measured fixed-input contrasts
packages.forbidden_claim: Causal explanation from confounded historical versions
packages.stop_criterion: Registered same-row projection and fixed-pilot summary-access contrasts terminal; any untested component effect is removed from retained claims.

packages.question: How does controlled heterogeneity affect correction?
packages.methods_and_scope: Six G* fixed-quantity K5 cells at severity 0.25/0.85 and seeds711/722/733
packages.metric: achieved skew, local error, oracle headroom, fidelity
packages.completed_scope: Registered contrasts terminal; fixed 1000 train/200 tune per client and equal-alpha mechanism target
packages.unresolved_scope: Full causal isolation of assignment and conditional relationships
packages.retained_claim: Severity findings apply to achieved empirical partitions
packages.forbidden_claim: Population-TV decomposition or universal causal mechanism
packages.stop_criterion: Both non-IID severities and three seeds have fixed per-client quantities and achieved-skew diagnostics; empirical identity is not called population TV.

packages.question: What finite-query conditional transfer follows?
packages.methods_and_scope: Elementary proposition, binary counterexample, 48 bound rows and 5112 student/direct triangles
packages.metric: ratio bound, support denominator, empirical triangle
packages.completed_scope: Algebra checked; rare support makes bounds weak and triggers abstention
packages.retained_claim: Finite-query bound under stated support assumptions
packages.stop_criterion: Finite-query proposition, counterexample, support curves and saved empirical triangle checks agree on their denominators and assumptions.

packages.question: What privacy, access and resource claims survive?
packages.methods_and_scope: Complete release ledger, atom-aware histogram epsilon1/4/8, four adapted FLAIM fits, three matched payload cells
packages.metric: adjacency/composition, serialized bytes, runtime, attack diagnostics
packages.completed_scope: Main pipeline nonprivate; model+metadata 1.915-2.866x matched raw bytes; conditional histogram epsilon13 if three settings released
packages.unresolved_scope: Whole-pipeline DP, WAN/security measurement and privacy-matched FLAIM ranking
packages.retained_claim: Separate conditional privacy reference and measured release costs
packages.stop_criterion: Every released-object class has access/privacy provenance; matched payload units, histogram adjacency/composition and main nonprivate status are explicit.
